t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Apparently tall hats gave higher returns. And they told me to switch up the colours and sizes to get a general idea of what gnomes give higher returns. They also told me to remember tp press the space bar.

vb_textbox.text: I found that the gnome with the tall hat gives more mushrooms. Try switch up the hat size and colours to see which gives even higher. Remember to press the spacebar to collect the basket. S is for the left gnome, K is for the right gnome. Good luck!
